title: Boston Whaler Cooler Chocks
keywords: boston whaler, cooler, chocks, plastic, tough, waterproof, replacement, marine, strong, UV resistant
description: CNC-machined HDPE replacement chocks for Boston Whaler 15-19ft center console coolers. Drop-in fit replaces the original wooden chocks that rot, warp, and fail over time. UV-stable, non-absorbent, and built to last. Teak chocks are available for a limited time only.
story: Originally designed by Boston Whaler, these chocks eventually degrade and rot. These starboard chocks will not rot.
